paragraphs.text: Scott McGough is an author who has written multiple novels and stories for Magic: The Gathering .
Scott is a former Duelist editor and a former Magic: The Gathering creative director (May 1998 - May 2000) for Wizards of the Coast .
Ron Spears used Scott McGough as the model for Opportunity . J. Robert King , the writer of the Invasion cycle , based the character Guff also on McGough.
Thus far, Scott McGough has written the following novels:
Legends Cycle II Assassin's Blade Emperor's Fist Champion's Trial
Chainer's Torment — Odyssey Cycle Book II
Kamigawa Cycle Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa
Time Spiral Cycle Time Spiral Planar Chaos (with Timothy Sanders ) Future Sight (with John Delaney )
Lorwyn Cycle (with Cory Herndon ) Lorwyn Morningtide
Shadowmoor Cycle (with Cory Herndon ) Eventide Ode to Mistmeadow Jack — Shadowmoor anthology
Keldon Fire — The Myths of Magic anthology
Keldon Staredown — The Dragons of Magic anthology
Family Man — The Secrets of Magic anthology
Who is Queen? — The Monsters of Magic anthology
Unnatural Predator — Dragons: Worlds Afire anthology.
